test_categorical_sample: test distributions.categorical_sample to sample from a categorical distribution given a JAX key and probability array
test_softmax_probs: test distributions.softmax to compute softmax probabilities from logits with configurable temperature
test_gaussian_kl_batch: test distributions.gaussian_diagonal to compute KL divergence between two diagonal Gaussian distributions in batch
test_squashed_gaussian_logprob: test distributions.squashed_gaussian to compute log probability of squashed Gaussian samples within action bounds
test_importance_sampling_ratios_batch: test distributions.categorical_importance_sampling_ratios to compute importance sampling ratios between two categorical policies
